valid_json.description: Defines reusable segments for the email header Jinja template.

description:
The collection named **email_header** defines a set of reusable segments for the email header Jinja template, providing a concise way to insert common markup while keeping the template clean and maintainable. The available segments are: - **title** – a single line that renders the subject inside an H1 tag: `

{{ subject }}

` - **logo** – a single line that inserts the company logo image with alt text: `` - **preheader** – a paragraph element styled as a pre‑header: `

{{ preheader_text }}

` Both the **title** and **logo** segments are marked as overwrite‑able, meaning they may replace any previously defined entries with the same keys.
